lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Real formed fold of about 25 deg between the rounded plate (patch 1) and the middle panel (patch 5). In perpendicular sections at 25%, 50% and 75%, the line sits on the convex outer-skin apex: the nearest surface point is 0.44, 0.02 and 0.24 mm away, and the inner skin is about 5.6 mm above. The line is parallel to the fold and runs edge to edge across the 99 mm panel width (t range 0 to 99.3 mm, every 1 mm station has surface within 1 mm). Face-on close-ups in both directions confirm it ends at the panel side edges.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Real formed fold of about 65 deg with a large radius, between the middle panel (patch 5) and the slotted plate (patch 4). In sections at 25%, 50% and 75%, the line sits at the bottom of the outer convex arc (the true surface apex, not the plane-intersection point): the nearest surface point is 0.32, 0.08 and 0.06 mm away. The line is parallel to the fold and runs edge to edge (t range 0 to 98.8 of 99.0 mm, full station coverage), ending at the start of the edge relief radii.
